notes.title: Bobo's Funzone Version 1.1.
notes.notes:
I went through all the feedback and negative reviews and have updated the game, so hopefully all new players will have a good time. Below is a list of everything that has been patched:

1.Updated the main menu and settings menu with more control options and a new design.

2.Fixed the monkey achievement, which was not working correctly.

3.Made the inventory button clearer — it’s now "I" to toggle the inventory, and you can remap the controls.

4.Explained how the torch works more clearly: the torch is meant not to shine when it's being charged up.

If there are any more issues let me know
